title: Move-In/Out
raw_text:
9/29/26, 9:39 AM

Move-In/Out

Purpose

This component enables you to process a customer move-in or move-out. In the case of a move-in, you can create a business

partner and contract account for the customer, or select existing ones. The contracts are then created and allocated to a utility
installation.

In a move-out, you terminate the customer's contract. If anew customer moves into the installation, the installation is allocated to
this customer's contract.

For more information, see Move-In and Move-Out.

Integration

Letters to the customer, such as welcome letters and move-out confirmations are created using the Print Workbench component.
The SAP Business Workflow component (BC-BMT-WFM) enables you to monitor and configure the workflow processes.

Features

You can have the system trigger a number of activities automatically. You can:

e process the entire transaction immediately and in full.

e create a final bill for the move-out customer.

e create a welcome letter for the move-in customer.

You can also configure the screen layout to suit your requirements.

Move-In/Out Processing

Use

You can use Move-In/Out Processing to process the following:

e Move-in/out (move-out with subsequent move-in) for a premise
e Move-in/out for a business partner

e Move-in

e Move-out

e Contract change

From the Move-In/Out initial screen, you can enter search parameters that act as transfer parameters for calling the move-in/out.
